questions.text: According to the Health NSO Survey 2025, what is the share of cardiovascular diseases among the total diseases in India?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 25.6 per cent

In News

  • According to the Health NSO Survey 2025, heart disease cases in India have nearly tripled over the last seven years, emerging as the biggest health challenge in the country.

Key Points

  • Cardiovascular diseases account for the highest share of 25.6 per cent of the total diseases in India, which is higher than all other categories including hormonal disturbances and blood sugar.
  • The survey reveals a sharp three-fold increase in cardiovascular cases from 1,333 cases per 100,000 population in 2017-18 to 3,891 cases in 2025.
  • Even young individuals in the 15 to 29 years age group have been found vulnerable, indicating an expanding threat across the population.

Additional Information

  • The Household Social Consumption: Health survey was conducted by the National Statistical Organisation (NSO) between January and December 2025.
  • The impact of cardiovascular diseases increases with age: it is 15.3 per cent for the 30-44 years age group, 30.1 per cent for 45-59 years, and 37.8 per cent for those over 60 years.
  • Regarding hospitalisation costs, heart ailments average Rs 69,451 in urban areas, making them more expensive than infections and respiratory diseases, though less expensive than cancer (Rs 1,04,424) and kidney failure (Rs 71,246).
  • In rural areas, heart disease treatments cost an average of Rs 47,135.

Important Points

  • The report marks a concerning decrease in infection-related diseases alongside a significant rise in non-communicable lifestyle diseases like heart ailments.
  • Data clearly shows that hospitalisations due to heart diseases in cities are higher than in rural areas, with the share of men being notably higher than that of women in both demographical segments.

questions.text: Which globally recognized standards body recently accredited O.P. Jindal Global University (JGU), making it the first Institution of Eminence in India to receive this distinction for its AI and data science programmes?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Data Science Council of America (DASCA)

In News

  • O.P. Jindal Global University (JGU), located in Sonipat, Haryana, has become the first Institution of Eminence in India to be accredited by the Data Science Council of America (DASCA).

Key Points

  • Data Science Council of America (DASCA): This is the globally recognized standards and accreditation body that establishes industry-aligned benchmarks for educational programmes in data science, artificial intelligence, and analytics. It directly awarded the accreditation to JGU.
  • World Data Science & AI Initiative (WDSAI): While relevant, WDSAI is a global platform led by DASCA under which the accreditation was awarded, rather than the primary accrediting body itself. It supports universities in adopting internationally benchmarked standards.
  • DASCA Professional Certification Board (DPCB) and Ethics Control Council (ECC): These entities are responsible for ensuring the rigor and ethical standards of the accredited programmes, not the primary institutions granting the university-wide accreditation.

Additional Information

  • Accredited Programmes: Seven of JGU's flagship AI and Data Science-related programmes have been aligned with DASCA standards. These include M.Sc. in AI & Data Science, B.A. in AI & Law, BBA (Hons.) Business Analytics, M.Des. (AI-powered UX), and three distinct MBA specializations.
  • Validity of Accreditation: The accreditation spans residential, non-residential, and online delivery formats, and it is valid through the year 2031.
  • Interdisciplinary Approach: According to Prof. Padmanabha Ramanujam, JGU's approach integrates technical expertise with critical thinking, ethical reasoning, and domain-specific knowledge.

Important Points

  • The achievement firmly positions O.P. Jindal Global University at the forefront of the integration of artificial intelligence and data science into the academic ecosystem.
  • It signals to learners and employers globally that JGU is prepared to equip its students for the realities of an AI-driven world economy.

questions.text: Where will the headquarters of the newly notified South Coast Railway zone be located?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Visakhapatnam

In News

  • The Union Government has officially notified the creation of a new zonal railway, the South Coast Railway (SCoR), with its headquarters situated in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.
  • The new railway zone is set to become operational effective June 1, 2026.

Key Points

  • New Zone Creation: The South Coast Railway has been carved out of the existing East Coast Railway (ECoR) and South Central Railway (SCR) zones.
  • Statutory Backing: It was established under sub-section (4) of Section 3 of the Railways Act, 1989.
  • Headquarters: The headquarters of the newly formed SCoR will be in Visakhapatnam. Thus, making Visakhapatnam the correct answer.
  • Divisions under SCoR: It will comprise the existing Guntakal, Guntur, and Vijayawada divisions of the South Central Railway, and a truncated Waltair division (renamed as the Visakhapatnam division).

Additional Information

  • East Coast Railway (ECoR): Headquartered at Bhubaneswar, ECoR will retain the Sambalpur division, the reorganised Khurda Road division, and the newly constituted Rayagada division.
  • South Central Railway (SCR): Headquartered at Secunderabad, SCR will retain the existing Hyderabad and Nanded divisions along with a reorganised Secunderabad division.
  • Jurisdictional Adjustments: The Central Government has adjusted the boundaries of various divisions across SCoR, ECoR, and SCR based on operational requirements, effective June 1, 2026.

Important Points

  • Bifurcation of Waltair Division: The existing Waltair division of ECoR is being split. One part forms the new Rayagada division under ECoR, while the remaining portion forms the Visakhapatnam division under SCoR.
  • Goal: The creation of this new zone is expected to significantly improve regional connectivity.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements regarding the recently commissioned Indian Coast Guard Ship (ICGS) Achal:

1. It is the latest vessel in the new-generation Adamya-class Fast Patrol Vessel series.
2. It incorporates more than 50 percent indigenous components.
3. It was formally commissioned into service by the Defence Minister of India.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Only 1 and 2

In News

  • The Indian Coast Guard marked a significant enhancement in its operational capability with the commissioning of Indian Coast Guard Ship (ICGS) Achal on May 09, 2026.

Key Points

  • Statement 1 is correct: ICGS Achal is the latest vessel in the new-generation Adamya-class Fast Patrol Vessel series.
  • Statement 2 is correct: Representing a significant milestone in India’s shipbuilding capabilities, the vessel incorporates more than 50 percent indigenous components.
  • Statement 3 is incorrect: The ship was formally commissioned into service by Shri A. Anbarasu, Additional Secretary & Director General (Acquisition), Ministry of Defence, and not the Defence Minister.

Additional Information

  • The name Achal translates to ‘firm’, symbolizing steadfast commitment to safeguarding national maritime interests.
  • The vessel was designed and built indigenously by Goa Shipyard Limited.
  • It will undertake a wide spectrum of maritime operations, including coastal surveillance, Search and Rescue (SAR), anti-smuggling operations, and marine pollution response.

Important Points

  • The development of the vessel aligns with the Government of India’s Atmanirbhar Bharat and Make in India initiatives.
  • The commissioning ceremony took place in the presence of Inspector General Tekur Sashi Kumar, Commander, Coast Guard Region (North-West).

questions.text:
Consider the following statements regarding the rare diseases management initiatives highlighted during the recent National Conference on Rare Diseases:

I. The National Policy for Rare Diseases, launched in 2021, categorizes rare diseases into three groups based on treatment requirements and cost implications.
II. Financial assistance for patients across all categories of rare diseases has been enhanced from ₹20 lakh to ₹50 lakh.
III. The number of Centres of Excellence (CoEs) for the diagnosis and treatment of rare diseases has been expanded to 20.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Only I and II.

In News

  • The Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare inaugurated a 2-day National Conference on Rare Diseases in New Delhi on 5th and 6th May 2026.

Key Points

  • Statement I is correct: The need for addressing rare diseases was institutionalized through the launch of the National Policy for Rare Diseases in 2021. It categorizes rare diseases into three groups based on treatment requirements and cost implications, enabling a structured approach to care.
  • Statement II is correct: In August 2022, the Ministry significantly enhanced the financial assistance for patients across all categories of rare diseases from ₹20 lakh to ₹50 lakh.
  • Statement III is incorrect: To strengthen institutional capacity for diagnosis and treatment, the number of Centres of Excellence (CoEs) has been expanded from 8 to 15 across multiple States and Union Territories (including two in North-East India), not 20.

Additional Information

  • The Unique Methods for Management of Inherited Disorders (UMMID) initiative, through its NIDAN Kendras, is operationalizing genetic counselling services, successfully supporting around 1,800 patients under the policy.
  • Most rare diseases are genetic and manifest early in life, with nearly 50% of new cases occurring in children.
  • The Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) has identified six repurposed drugs to improve outcomes for rare diseases and is actively advancing frontier technologies like CAR-T cell therapy.

Important Points

  • The Government of India has proactively exempted life-saving drugs for rare diseases from basic customs duty to improve accessibility and affordability.
  • In 2026, over 50 sensitization workshops were conducted nationwide by CoEs in collaboration with the Ministry to enhance awareness and stakeholder coordination.

questions.text: Who assumed charge as the Chairman & Managing Director (CMD) of Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) in May 2026?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Dr. Ashok Kumar Panda

In News

  • Dr. Ashok Kumar Panda assumed charge as the Chairman & Managing Director (CMD) of Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) on 09 May, 2026.

Key Points

  • Dr. Ashok Kumar Panda previously served as the Director (Finance) of the company and held the additional charge of Director (Commercial) for about nine months prior to this appointment.
  • He began his journey with SAIL in 1992 as a Management Trainee (Technical) after completing his B.E. in Electrical Engineering.
  • Over three decades, he has held diverse responsibilities across multiple plants, gaining extensive experience in operational, financial, and commercial domains, directly making him the correct appointee for the top leadership position.

Additional Information

  • During his tenure as Director (Finance), Dr. Panda spearheaded strategic initiatives aimed at improving operational efficiency and profitability.
  • In his role as Director (Commercial), he focused on enhancing Net Sales Realisation (NSR), reducing inventory levels, and strengthening product branding.
  • He is widely respected as a people-centric leader with an inclusive leadership style and strong execution capabilities.

Important Points

  • Capacity Expansion: Upon assuming charge, Dr. Panda outlined that SAIL is on track for its next phase of capacity expansion to 35 MTPA.
  • Strategic Priorities: His immediate priorities for the company include placing the highest priority on safety across workplaces and strengthening raw material security through domestic mining and exploration of overseas assets.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements regarding World Asthma Day:

I. It is observed every year on the first Tuesday of May.

II. It was started in 1998 by the World Health Organization (WHO).

III. The theme for 2026 is “Access to anti-inflammatory inhalers for everyone with asthma, still an urgent need.”

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Only I and III

In News

  • World Asthma Day will be observed on 5 May 2026, focusing on making anti-inflammatory inhalers accessible to everyone globally.

Key Points

  • Statement I is correct: World Asthma Day is observed every year on the first Tuesday of May across the world. In 2026, it falls on 5 May.
  • Statement II is incorrect: The day was started in 1998 by the Global Initiative for Asthma (GINA), not the World Health Organization (WHO), with the sole aim of improving asthma awareness and care globally.
  • Statement III is correct: The theme for 2026 is “Access to anti-inflammatory inhalers for everyone with asthma, still an urgent need.”

Additional Information

  • Asthma is a chronic condition that affects the airways, making it difficult to breathe.
  • Common asthma symptoms include shortness of breath, wheezing cough, tightness in the chest, and coughing at night.
  • Uneasiness or difficulty breathing after exercise and repeated cases of chest infections are also common triggers and symptoms for asthma patients.

Important Points

  • The 2026 theme emphasizes closing the global healthcare gap by ensuring access to essential medications regardless of a patient's geographic location or economic background.
  • GINA encourages governments and healthcare organizations to work collectively for better asthma management globally so that no one is denied necessary care.

questions.text: What is the theme of India’s Chairship for the Kimberley Process in 2026?

options.text: Coordination, capacity building, and customs clearance

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Credibility, compliance, and consumer confidence

In News

  • The Ministry of Commerce & Industry announced that India hosted the Kimberley Process Intersessional Meeting 2026 in Mumbai from May 11 to May 14, 2026.

Key Points

  • India's Chairship theme for 2026: The primary focus of the 2026 Chairship revolves around the 3Cs — credibility, compliance, and consumer confidence in the natural diamond sector.
  • This theme places a strong emphasis on strengthening the future of responsibly sourced natural diamonds through constructive dialogue and international collaboration.
  • KP Chair 2026: Addressing the gathering, Shri Suchindra Misra highlighted that natural diamonds represent a sustainable product and the Kimberley Process remains one of the most progressive certification systems globally.
  • The deliberations focused on the implementation of the Kimberley Process Certification Scheme, monitoring and compliance mechanisms, artisanal and alluvial diamond production, and statistics.

Additional Information

  • Kimberley Process Certification Scheme (KPCS): It was established pursuant to the United Nations General Assembly Resolution 55/56 (2000).
  • The primary aim of KPCS is to prevent the flow of conflict diamonds into the legitimate global diamond trade.
  • Global Participation: At present, the Kimberley Process has 60 Participants representing 86 countries. The European Union and its Member States participate as a single bloc.

Important Points

  • India's Strategic Role: India formally assumed the Chairship of the Kimberley Process on January 1, 2026, reaffirming its deep commitment to transparency and responsible sourcing.
  • India holds a prominent position globally as one of the world's leading centres for diamond cutting and polishing, thereby playing a critical role in advancing the objectives of the Kimberley Process.

questions.text: Who among the following Indian educators has been announced as the regional winner for South Asia in the 2026 Cambridge Dedicated Teacher Awards?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Soma Mandal

In News

  • Soma Mandal, an Indian science teacher, has been announced as the regional winner for South Asia in the 2026 Cambridge Dedicated Teacher Awards.

Key Points

  • Soma Mandal was recognised for her outstanding work in encouraging students to actively engage with environmental issues and take part in the fight against climate change.
  • She is one of the nine regional winners selected this year globally by the International Education group at Cambridge University Press & Assessment.
  • Other Options Context:
    • Aisha Kiran is the regional winner representing Pakistan.
    • Joanne Newman is the regional winner representing Saudi Arabia.
    • Shingang Ding is the regional winner representing China.

Additional Information

  • The Cambridge Dedicated Teacher Awards are organised to recognise outstanding teachers globally. For the 2026 edition, more than 12,000 nominations were received from 126 countries.
  • From the initial nominations, judges shortlisted 90 teachers, and from that list, nine were selected as regional winners.
  • One of these nine teachers will go on to become the overall global winner, chosen through public voting.
  • Rewards: The regional winners will receive £500 worth of books for their class, a trophy, and publicity for their school over the coming year. Their names will also appear on a “Thank you” page in new Cambridge textbooks, which will be released in November 2026.

Important Points

  • Soma Mandal represents India and the South Asia region at the 2026 Cambridge Dedicated Teacher Awards, empowering young learners to explore climate challenges and develop practical solutions.

questions.text: What is the next port of call for IOS Sagar after its departure from Chattogram, Bangladesh?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Colombo, Sri Lanka

In News

  • Indian Navy’s INS Sunayna, deployed under the Indian Ocean Ship (IOS) SAGAR initiative, departed Chattogram, Bangladesh, on 10 May 2026.

Key Points

  • After a successful port call in Bangladesh, IOS Sagar is presently enroute to its next port of call at Colombo, Sri Lanka.
  • The visit to Bangladesh was marked by professional engagements, maritime cooperation, and cultural exchanges with the Bangladesh Navy (BN).
  • Therefore, the correct destination for the ship's continued operational deployment is Colombo, Sri Lanka.

Additional Information

  • During the visit, the Commanding Officer called on senior officials including the Commander BN Fleet (COMBAN) and Commander Chattogram Naval Area (COMCHIT).
  • The crew visited the Bangladesh Naval Academy and interacted with officer cadets and faculty members.
  • Personnel from 16 partner nations were embarked onboard IOS Sagar during this operational deployment.

Important Points

  • On departure, IOS Sagar participated in a Passage Exercise (PASSEX) with BNS Protoy and Bangladesh Navy air assets to enhance interoperability.
  • The exercise included coordinated maritime drills and advanced surface manoeuvres aimed at enhancing operational cooperation.

questions.text: Which yoga posture was performed by over 6,000 participants at the Yoga Mahotsav in Hyderabad to set a new Asia Book of Records?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Bhujangasana

In News

  • Over 6,000 participants performed Bhujangasana to set an Asia Book of Records milestone during the Yoga Mahotsav in Hyderabad.
  • The event marked the 50-day countdown to the International Day of Yoga (IDY) 2026.

Key Points

  • Bhujangasana Record: Over 6,000 enthusiasts performed Bhujangasana in unison at the serene spiritual centre, Kanha Shanti Vanam.
  • Historic Milestone: This simultaneous performance entered the Asia Book of Records for the largest gathering performing the asana simultaneously, reflecting the spirit of collective participation.
  • Organisers: The event was organised by the Morarji Desai National Institute of Yoga (MDNIY) under the Ministry of Ayush.

Additional Information

  • Upcoming Event: The next Yoga Mahotsav, marking the 25-day countdown to IDY 2026, will be organised at Khajuraho, Madhya Pradesh.
  • Yoga 365 Campaign: The Ministry of Ayush, in collaboration with Habuild and MDNIY, launched this initiative to encourage citizens to make Yoga an integral part of their daily lives.
  • Free Training: A 100-day free Yoga training programme is being conducted until June 21, offering Yog Mitra certification to over one lakh individuals.
  • Global Presence: Dignitaries from over 20 countries participated, and yoga sessions are planned over six months during the World Expo 2025 in Osaka, Japan.

Important Points

  • Union Minister Shri G. Kishan Reddy emphasized that Hyderabad should emerge as a global hub for Yoga and holistic wellness.
  • Shri Prataprao Jadhav highlighted that Yoga offers a practical solution to modern-day challenges and is a key to building a Viksit Bharat by 2047.

questions.text: With which organisation has the National University of Singapore's Institute of Systems Science (NUS-ISS) signed an MoU to build AI governance and digital leadership capacity for Indian enterprises?

options.text: Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce & Industry (FICCI)
National Association of Software and Service Companies (NASSCOM)
Associated Chambers of Commerce and Industry of India (ASSOCHAM)

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Confederation of Indian Industry (CII)

In News

  • The Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) and NUS-ISS of the National University of Singapore have signed a strategic Memorandum of Understanding (MoU).
  • The partnership aims to advance digital leadership and responsible AI governance among Indian enterprises through an exclusive executive certification programme.

Key Points

  • Joint Programme Delivery: Under the agreement, CII and NUS-ISS will jointly deliver the "Leadership Programme on Artificial Intelligence and Governance".
  • Target Audience: The capacity-building programme is tailored to equip board members, CXOs, and senior decision-makers with insights into AI, digital governance, innovation leadership, and cybersecurity.
  • Future Goals: The initiative formalises and expands upon pilot runs, planning half-yearly programmes in 2026, 2027, and 2028, with a target to train over 100 executives by the end of 2026.

Additional Information

  • Event Details: The MoU was exchanged at the CII Annual Business Summit 2026 in New Delhi.
  • Key Attendees: Exchanged in the presence of Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu, Singapore High Commissioner to India Simon Wong, and CII President Rajiv Memani.
  • Anchoring Hub: The CII Global Leadership Centre located in Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh, will anchor these joint programmes on leadership and digitalisation.
  • Strategic Alignment: The initiative complements the 'Digitalisation' and 'Skilling' pillars under the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership between India and Singapore.

Important Points

  • Previous Success: The initiative builds on three successful pilot editions held in Singapore (Nov 2024, May 2025, Nov 2025), which trained more than 65 Indian industry executives.
  • About NUS-ISS: Established in 1981, the institute has trained over 210,000 digital leaders and professionals from more than 9,400 corporate organisations.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements regarding the Emergency Credit Line Guarantee Scheme (ECLGS) 5.0 approved by the Union Cabinet:

I. It aims to provide credit guarantee coverage of 100% for MSMEs and 90% for non-MSMEs as well as the airline sector.

II. It targets a total additional credit flow of Rs. 2,55,000 crore, which includes Rs. 5,000 crore for airlines.

III. The tenor of the loan for MSMEs and non-MSMEs is 7 years from the date of the first disbursement, including a moratorium of 2 years.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Only I and II

In News

  • The Union Cabinet, chaired by the Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, has approved the Emergency Credit Line Guarantee Scheme (ECLGS) 5.0.
  • The scheme provides crucial credit support to eligible business borrowers and airlines to manage short-term liquidity mismatches due to the West Asia Crisis.

Key Points

  • Statement I is correct: The scheme guarantees 100% coverage for MSMEs and 90% coverage for non-MSMEs, as well as the airline sector.
  • Statement II is correct: It targets a total additional credit flow of Rs. 2,55,000 crore, which explicitly includes Rs. 5,000 crore allocated for the airline sector.
  • Statement III is incorrect: The tenor of the loan for MSMEs and non-MSMEs (excluding the airline sector) is 5 years from the date of the first disbursement, which includes a moratorium of 1 year. The 7-year tenor with a 2-year moratorium is strictly for the airline sector.

Additional Information

  • The credit guarantee coverage is provided through the National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company Limited (NCGTC) to Member Lending Institutions (MLIs).
  • Eligible borrowers are those with existing working capital limits and standard accounts as of March 31, 2026.
  • The duration of the scheme covers all loans sanctioned up to March 31, 2027, and the Guarantee Fee is Nil.

Important Points

  • Quantum of Support: For businesses, it is up to 20% of peak working capital utilized during Q4 FY 26, capped at Rs. 100 crore.
  • For airlines, the additional credit goes up to 100%, capped at Rs. 1,500 crore per borrower.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements regarding the India-Africa relationship and the India-Africa Forum Summit (IAFS):

Statement I: The 4th India-Africa Forum Summit is scheduled to be hosted by New Delhi on May 31, succeeding the previous summit which was held in 2015.
Statement II: Bilateral trade between India and Africa currently stands at around $85 billion, and 39 African nations have already joined the International Solar Alliance.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Both Statement I and Statement II

In News

  • New Delhi is preparing to host the 4th India-Africa Forum Summit (IAFS) after a decade, signaling a renewed push to strengthen India’s engagement with Africa amid intensifying geopolitical competition.

Key Points

  • Statement I is correct: The 4th India-Africa Forum Summit (IAFS) is scheduled for May 31 in New Delhi. This comes after a significant gap of a decade, as the previous summit was held in 2015. The process was primarily disrupted due to the Covid-19 pandemic and shifting global priorities.
  • Statement II is correct: Africa is a strategically important partner for India. The current bilateral trade stands at around $85 billion. Furthermore, indicating strong energy and developmental cooperation, 39 African nations have officially joined the International Solar Alliance (ISA).

Additional Information

  • Over the past decade, India has opened 17 new diplomatic missions in Africa, taking its total diplomatic presence to 46 countries.
  • The African continent accounts for nearly 10 per cent of India’s energy imports.
  • India contributes approximately 5,000 peacekeepers to various UN missions in Africa.
  • Digital cooperation framework agreements have been signed by India with seven African countries.

Important Points

  • The main summit on May 31 will be preceded by senior officials’ meetings on May 28 and a foreign ministers’ meeting on May 29.
  • Following the summit, a high-profile International Big Cat Alliance meeting is scheduled on June 1, involving several African nations.
  • Other engagements planned alongside the summit include think tank dialogues and an India-Africa Film Festival.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements regarding the 1st International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA) Summit:

1. The summit is scheduled to be hosted by India in June 2026 in New Delhi.
2. The IBCA has been established exclusively for the conservation of five big cats: Lion, Tiger, Leopard, Cheetah, and Jaguar.
3. A key outcome of the summit will be the adoption of the first-ever global declaration on big cat conservation, titled the ‘Delhi Declaration’.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Only 1 and 3

In News

  • Union Environment Minister launched the website and logo for the 1st International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA) Summit 2026, to be held in New Delhi.

Key Points

  • Statement 1 is correct: India will host the first IBCA Summit on 1st – 2nd June 2026 in New Delhi.
  • Statement 2 is incorrect: The IBCA has been established for the conservation of seven big cats - Lion, Tiger, Leopard, Snow Leopard, Cheetah, Jaguar, and Puma, not five.
  • Statement 3 is correct: A key outcome of the Summit would be the adoption of the first-ever global declaration on big cat conservation, titled the ‘Delhi Declaration’.

Additional Information

  • The Summit is guided by the theme ‘Save Big Cats, Save Humanity, Save Ecosystem’.
  • The IBCA is an inter-governmental international organisation headquartered in India, launched in 2023 by Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi.
  • The logo of the summit features the seven big cat species at its core, encircled by a lotus-inspired design representing the five elements of nature.

Important Points

  • Union Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change: Shri Bhupender Yadav
